##### Project general facts

The Chedi Private Residences is the world's first standalone private branded residence under The Chedi name, rising over fifty storeys above the city. Designed by the award-winning Studio Bruno Guelaff, the tower features a sleek glass facade and an exclusive collection of sky villas. Residences range from two-, three- and four-bedroom villas to five-bedroom duplex villas with private pools, a six-bedroom Sky Mansion and the eight-bedroom triplex Pinnacle Mansion crowning the building.

Amenities unfold across three social levels. The Ground Social features valet parking, an arrival lobby, a Chedi Navigator and concierge desk and a residents-only restaurant. The Resort Social offers a lagoon-inspired pool with cabanas and aqua cabanas, a young residents' club, an owners' cinema, private padel courts, a jogging track, a barbecue garden, a spa and a health club with saunas, plunge baths and jacuzzis. The Sky Social adds an adults-only infinity pool, a sunken lounge, a sky bar, a cafe, an omakase dining experience and a walk-in cigar humidor.

Open-plan living and dining spaces are framed by floor-to-ceiling windows, while expansive sky gardens extend each home towards the horizon. Interiors feature social kitchens by Italian designer Pedini with Miele appliances, elegant travertine floors and countertops, and bathrooms with smart mirrors and Kohler and Hansgrohe fixtures. Larger homes include private elevators, maid's and driver's rooms, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Barsha sits along Sheikh Zayed Road between Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai, close to Dubai Media City, Dubai Internet City and the Emirates Golf Club. The district combines business hubs, hotels and residential neighbourhoods, with sweeping views towards Palm Jumeirah, Burj Al Arab and the city skyline from its high-rise towers. The area offers a vibrant mix of restaurants, cafes, gyms and everyday services for residents and professionals alike.

Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro provide direct connections to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Mall of the Emirates and Downtown Dubai. Palm Jumeirah and the beaches of Al Sufouh are a short drive away, while Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport are both within easy reach. International schools, hospitals and shopping centres such as Mall of the Emirates serve families across the surrounding districts.

The Sheikh Zayed Road corridor near Al Barsha is one of Dubai's most central and well-connected addresses, with strong demand from executives and high-net-worth families. Branded sky villas of this scale are in very limited supply in the city. Freehold ownership, exceptional connectivity and the prestige of an internationally recognised hospitality brand underpin long-term value and resilient resale prospects for owners and investors.
